key_insight: MS-Exam-Gen is a reproducible, source-grounded workflow for building and auditing a text-based multiple-choice benchmark to test LLM knowledge about multiple sclerosis MRI concepts.
clinical_relevance: It helps assess whether medical LLMs can answer narrow, evolving MS-MRI knowledge questions reliably, which is important for safer clinical knowledge support and evaluation.
method: Indexed 66 expert sources into 4,289 retrieval chunks
Generated and filtered a locked 3,058-item MCQ candidate set across 16 topics and 53 subtopics
Used automated quality audits, same-family consistency checks, and calibration to reduce answer cues
evidence_signal: Across 12 LLM endpoints, the benchmark produced 36,696 item-level predictions and showed a 42.8-point accuracy spread, from 89.7% to 46.9%.
watch_item: The benchmark is not clinically certified, and results may still be affected by option-order sensitivity and the absence of full expert adjudication.
paper_title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
